snippet.title: Vending Machine Co. - Release Date Announcement Trailer (Steam)
snippet.description:
Run your kawaii vending machine company! A relaxing sim where you manage, restock, and repair your vending machines across a charming Japanese city. Pick neighborhoods, stock up on snacks, and set the perfect price. Upgrade your machines and keep them stocked, one soda at a time!

Vending Machine Co. is releasing on 25th April! 
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3622640/Vending_Machine_Co/
